obligations.scope: Invokes model and canonical unit production ownership for all fixture models, two native datasheets, one army.

obligations.order135_obligation: A starting-singleton is below half-strength when its current wounds are less than half its W characteristic.
obligations.scope: Reads BelowHalfStrengthContext from native singleton wounds. Odd five and even twelve starting wounds distinguish all three predicates including exact equality.

obligations.scope: Production predicate uses surviving bodies across 0–5 and ignores wound totals. Starting count captured explicitly in the fixture.

obligations.scope: Compiles generic grants on physical native models. Asserts typed lifetime default, actual weapon-profile increase and restoration at matching boundary, with out-of-position controls. No late lifecycle consumer asserted.

obligations.scope: Production healing queue selects only previously destroyed models of this unit, clamps completion at the missing count, recovers the initial wounds and preserves gear and model identity. Explicit reserves setup.

obligations.scope: Production healing queue selects only previously destroyed models of this unit, clamps completion at the missing count, recovers the initial wounds and preserves gear and model identity. Explicit reserves setup.

obligations.scope: Production healing queue selects only previously destroyed models of this unit, clamps completion at the missing count, recovers the initial wounds and preserves gear and model identity. Explicit reserves setup.

obligations.scope: Calls the real phase-start coherency geometry gate for an accepted exact neighbor, too-far neighbor and near model absent at phase start. Geometry owner scope.

obligations.order135_obligation: A returned model may engage an enemy unit only if its unit was already engaged with that enemy unit.
obligations.scope: Real revival engagement gate accepts an endpoint by a different model of the previously engaged rules unit and rejects a newly engaged rules unit.

obligations.order135_obligation: A revived Leader or Support remains part of its attached rules unit and returns to it if possible.
obligations.scope: Accepted production healing preserves attached formation, original equipped Leader and assignment record. Explicit reserves and attachment setup.

obligations.scope: Production healing distinguishes a restored embarked casualty from zero-wound return at capacity and verifies no damage/destruction trigger events. Constructed capacity boundary.

obligations.order135_obligation: Capacity destruction does not trigger destroyed-model rules.
obligations.scope: Production healing distinguishes a restored embarked casualty from zero-wound return at capacity and verifies no damage/destruction trigger events. Constructed capacity boundary.

obligations.order135_obligation: Embarked units are not on the battlefield.
obligations.scope: Presence evaluator lists every target model as offboard in reserves and embarked controls, using explicit cargo capacity and native bodies.

obligations.order135_obligation: Units in Strategic Reserves are not on the battlefield.
obligations.scope: Presence evaluator lists every target model as offboard in reserves and embarked controls, using explicit cargo capacity and native bodies.

obligations.order135_obligation: Other units cannot see an off-battlefield unit.
obligations.scope: Spatial ability relationship bars offboard cross-unit selection with visibility/range while retaining own-ability recognition. Qualifies ability-targeting path only.

obligations.order135_obligation: An off-battlefield unit is visible to itself.
obligations.scope: The embarked and reserve relationship owner classifies each source as visible to itself.

obligations.order135_obligation: An off-battlefield unit cannot see other units.
obligations.scope: An off-board source cannot establish the qualifying visibility relationship to another unit, and the dependent target selector excludes it.

obligations.order135_obligation: Distance to or from an off-battlefield unit cannot be measured.
obligations.scope: Actual reserved and embarked target models are off the battlefield. Spatial relation is excluded in either direction, while own-effect eligibility survives under its separate source permission.

obligations.order135_obligation: An off-battlefield unit is within range of its own abilities.
obligations.scope: Self-range eligibility survives both typed off-board locations at the actual ability and target-selection boundaries.

obligations.order135_obligation: Visibility-dependent or measured-range-dependent selection cannot select an off-battlefield unit except its own abilities.
obligations.scope: Spatial ability relationship bars offboard cross-unit selection with visibility/range while retaining own-ability recognition. Qualifies ability-targeting path only.

obligations.order135_obligation: An off-battlefield unit may use rules whose own conditions remain met.
obligations.scope: An unrestricted off-board own ability remains eligible. A battlefield-restricted counterpart is excluded.

obligations.order135_obligation: Army-wide effects and army-selection rules can still affect off-battlefield units.
obligations.scope: Actual unqualified army-selection consumer retains eligibility offboard. This asserts the selection path, without separately generalizing all army-wide effects.

obligations.order135_obligation: Currently shocked off-battlefield units require Command battle-shock.
obligations.scope: Current Shock requires a Command roll even above half strength for embarked and reserve occupants. Destroyed units are excluded.

obligations.order135_obligation: Off-battlefield units at or below half-strength require Command battle-shock.
obligations.scope: Among live previously unshocked off-board units, only those at or below half count produce the required Command roll.

obligations.order135_obligation: Other model or unit excludes the original model or rules unit.
obligations.scope: Exact applied target IDs exclude the source where required while differentiating native peer and enemy, including identical-datasheet instances.

obligations.order135_obligation: Two instances of the same datasheet remain different units.
obligations.scope: Exact applied target IDs exclude the source where required while differentiating native peer and enemy, including identical-datasheet instances.

obligations.order135_obligation: The same models may be split only once.
obligations.scope: A valid split retains the physical membership and the production builder rejects splitting a successor's same models again.

obligations.order135_obligation: A pre-battle split unit has Starting Strength equal to its own resulting model count.
obligations.scope: Real split materialization gives each resultant unit exactly its own retained model count for starting strength.

obligations.order135_obligation: A split produces exactly two units with counts as equal as possible.
obligations.scope: Five native models form exactly two successor partitions of two and three without duplication.

obligations.order135_obligation: The chosen model membership of each split unit is retained.
obligations.scope: Either chosen subset is preserved. The complement is equivalent physical identities and initial counts, with the original army still immutable.

obligations.order135_obligation: An impossible specified split size falls back to the source-mandated balanced two-way split.
obligations.scope: An impossible (5,5) request still yields the legal (2,3) balance and the precise selected physical model memberships.

obligations.order135_obligation: A unit descriptor applies when at least one member model meets it.
obligations.scope: An attached Character makes the rules unit carry CHARACTER while the Bodyguard models individually lack it.

obligations.order135_obligation: A member's descriptor does not grant it to other models.
obligations.scope: The member's descriptor is visible to the rules unit but does not bleed into the other physical models' tags.

obligations.order135_obligation: An explicit unit-wide ability grant applies to every model.
obligations.scope: The explicit compiled unit grant produces commitments for every physical member in the target inventory.

obligations.order135_obligation: Indefinite a model, unit, or object means one or more when no exact count is specified.
obligations.scope: The unqualified unit reference actually resolves multiple native units. Independent indefinite model and object selectors are not exercised here.

obligations.order135_obligation: A reminder token is never a model for any rule.
obligations.scope: Initializing the native token's resource ledger changes neither physical scenario inventory, placed physical models nor starting strength. No token relocation consumer.

obligations.order135_obligation: A reminder token does not obstruct another model's movement; it is repositioned if needed.
obligations.scope: Native Aspect Shrine resource changes neither battlefield geometry nor model inventory, and a witnessed path stays valid. The fixture has no physical reminder token to reposition.

obligations.order135_obligation: A newly added unit establishes its Starting Strength at the time it joins the army.
obligations.scope: A typed native army addition writes Starting Strength from its five physical model IDs at entry and rejects repeating the same addition.

obligations.order135_obligation: All types of model includes both armies.
obligations.scope: The generic target language reaches both armies, and a separate native unit grant reaches all its physical models. The literal all-types model selector is not isolated across both armies.

obligations.order135_obligation: All types of model includes every keyword class.
obligations.scope: The compiled friendly grant reaches each physical model of four native datasheets spanning Infantry, Character, Beast and a Monster/Vehicle class. The case does not exercise an unrestricted all-types selector against both owners.

obligations.order135_obligation: Exactly one player is active and the other opposing, with roles changing together.
obligations.scope: The stored turn owner and the effective acting controller remain distinct through nested scopes, with LIFO return to a single controller.

obligations.order135_obligation: The first-turn player is active outside either player's turn.
obligations.scope: Boundary active-player function returns the first player at both round boundaries in both turn orders, including when state records the other player.

obligations.order135_obligation: The turn owner is active unless an explicit selected-unit scope overrides it.
obligations.scope: Before an override and after cleanup the turn owner is active. Explicit scope selects the appropriate actor without changing turn ownership.

obligations.order135_obligation: A moving unit's controller is active until its move ends.
obligations.scope: The typed native movement controller owns its scoped active-player state through nested completion and release.

obligations.order135_obligation: A shooting unit's controller is active until its attacks resolve.
obligations.scope: An explicit shooting controller is active for the nested selected-attack scope and the turn owner returns afterward.

obligations.order135_obligation: A fighting unit's controller is active until its attacks resolve.
obligations.scope: Constructed nested Fight scope exposes the acting unit's controller until the scope is popped, then restores the turn player. The test does not span actual attacks or verify which attack completion pops the scope.

obligations.order135_obligation: A player's army-rule effects belong to that player.
obligations.scope: Per-player indexes feed the actual ability resolution kernel. Source owner's effect reaches its own model context and not the opponent's. Constructed rule definitions.

obligations.order135_obligation: A player's detachment-rule effects belong to that player.
obligations.scope: A typed detachment effect executes for only its owner's current native unit and cannot affect the peer.

obligations.order135_obligation: A used Stratagem belongs to the player using it.
obligations.scope: The actual use is stored solely in the user's ledger and only that actor sees the usage restriction.

obligations.order135_obligation: Enhancement effects belong to the player controlling their bearer.
obligations.scope: A typed enhancement indexes and applies only for the controlling player and expected unit bearer.

obligations.order135_obligation: Datasheet effects belong to the player controlling their source unit.
obligations.scope: Per-player indexes feed the actual ability resolution kernel. Source owner's effect reaches its own model context and not the opponent's. Constructed rule definitions.

obligations.order135_obligation: Usage restrictions apply only to the owner of the rule.
obligations.scope: Actual ability and Stratagem usage restrict the using player. The peer's independent lookup remains open.

obligations.order135_obligation: A mission rule used by a player is that player's rule.
obligations.scope: Actual ordering service preserves a player-owned mission rule's player tier behind the eligible active-player participant.

obligations.order135_obligation: Unowned always-active mission rules resolve before active-player rules.
obligations.scope: Real finite sequencing builder and applier require unowned mission options first, then mandatory and optional in each player tier. Exact offered option sets and owner choices verified for both active players; assembled timing window.

obligations.order135_obligation: The active player chooses ordering among unowned mission rules.
obligations.scope: Real finite sequencing builder and applier require unowned mission options first, then mandatory and optional in each player tier. Exact offered option sets and owner choices verified for both active players; assembled timing window.

obligations.order135_obligation: Active-player mandatory rules resolve first in that player's chosen order.
obligations.scope: Real finite sequencing builder and applier require unowned mission options first, then mandatory and optional in each player tier. Exact offered option sets and owner choices verified for both active players; assembled timing window.

obligations.order135_obligation: Active-player selected optional rules resolve second in that player's chosen order.
obligations.scope: Real finite sequencing builder and applier require unowned mission options first, then mandatory and optional in each player tier. Exact offered option sets and owner choices verified for both active players; assembled timing window.

obligations.order135_obligation: Opposing-player mandatory rules resolve third in that player's chosen order.
obligations.scope: Real finite sequencing builder and applier require unowned mission options first, then mandatory and optional in each player tier. Exact offered option sets and owner choices verified for both active players; assembled timing window.

obligations.order135_obligation: Opposing-player selected optional rules resolve fourth in that player's chosen order.
obligations.scope: Real finite sequencing builder and applier require unowned mission options first, then mandatory and optional in each player tier. Exact offered option sets and owner choices verified for both active players; assembled timing window.

obligations.order135_obligation: Newly triggered rules wait until every unresolved original rule in that timing has resolved.
obligations.scope: Real sequencing batch keeps the old pending rule eligible and opens a new generation only after the old collection completes.

obligations.order135_obligation: Distances use inches.
obligations.scope: The live distance owner exposes the recorded physical gap in inches and matches both inclusive checks.

obligations.order135_obligation: Distance measurement is not restricted to a decision timing.
obligations.scope: A direct physical distance query succeeds without a decision request or phase-timing permission.

obligations.order135_obligation: Default distance uses the closest part of the model's base.
obligations.scope: Surface-to-surface distance matches the true closest circle parts, which is symmetric and distinct from centre distance.

obligations.order135_obligation: Within a distance includes equality at the boundary.
obligations.scope: Equality passes the one-inch Within predicate and the two-inch whole-surface comparison, while just-outside fails.

obligations.order135_obligation: A model is within when any part of its base is within.
obligations.scope: A closest part inside qualifies Within even when the farthest base part fails Wholly Within. One in-range physical unit member is sufficient.

obligations.order135_obligation: A unit is within when at least one member model is within.
obligations.scope: One in-range member among farther members suffices, including exactly on the one-inch edge. With that member just outside range the actual unit-level query fails.

obligations.order135_obligation: A model is wholly within when every part of its base is within.
obligations.scope: The circle comparison reaches the farthest base edge. Independent declared FRAME geometry follows the tested whole-height distinction.

obligations.order135_obligation: A unit is wholly within when every member model is wholly within.
obligations.scope: The proposed successor asserts whole-unit table-quarter assignment, a different question from every base being within a specified distance. The individual FRAME range control cannot establish aggregation across members. No direct active unit-distance assertion was bound.

obligations.order135_obligation: FRAME wholly-within measurement includes every part of the model.
obligations.scope: The actual measurement owner checks a constructed FRAME prism's full height. With identical base and excess height, the FRAME fails the range test and the ordinary base passes.

obligations.order135_obligation: Closest means the minimum model/unit distance to the rule user.
obligations.scope: Equal minimum single-model enemy units remain available and the farther unit is excluded. The prior public Surge request includes exactly the nearest or tied candidates. Native Fight rejects a path towards the farther selected target and accepts the path towards the nearest while preserving the setup's engagement constraints.

obligations.order135_obligation: The controlling player chooses among equally closest candidates.
obligations.scope: The native Surge request exposes both tied targets. The owner-side target validation accepts either named tied unit and rejects omitted or non-nearest choices. Scope is the Surge choice path.

obligations.order135_obligation: An as-close-as-possible move reaches base contact if a legal path and all other constraints allow it.
obligations.scope: The witnessed contact goal finds a base-contact endpoint at four inches and no witness at three. The adjacent public Fight cases reject breaking a required engagement and accept preserving both. Neither directly rejects a shorter submission when contact is legally attainable in an action that specifically orders maximum approach.

obligations.order135_obligation: If contact is unattainable, the move reaches the closest legal endpoint.
obligations.scope: With a legal three-inch path and unattainable contact, the actual Surge endpoint owner accepts the maximum endpoint and rejects a shorter legal endpoint. Bounded to the recorded obstacle-free witnessed case.

obligations.order135_obligation: A model already maximally close cannot change position.
obligations.scope: A native model already in contact may remain still and cannot translate by 0.001 or 1 inch. The test does not vary facing or place a model at the closest legal non-contact point imposed by a separate constraint.

obligations.order135_obligation: An immobile already-maximally-close model still counts as making the instructed move.
obligations.scope: An already-touching model using an explicit zero-length pile-in path is not classified as declining to move. Resolution reports pile_in with unchanged placement and a valid path. This establishes the native touching model case at the resolver boundary.

obligations.order135_obligation: An as-close-as-possible objective move ends in objective range if legally achievable.
obligations.scope: Legal witness endpoints include reaching the objective range when attainable and reject a nonoptimal endpoint when the closer legal endpoint exists.

obligations.order135_obligation: If objective range is unattainable, the move reaches the closest legal endpoint.
obligations.scope: When the objective is out of range, the exact endpoint owner accepts the maximum three-inch approach and rejects a 2.5-inch path. The same fixture separately tests moving into range and moving within or leaving range. Constructed witnessed geometry bounds this result.

obligations.order135_obligation: A model already in objective range may move its full legal budget while ending in that range.
obligations.scope: An already-in-range model spends its one-inch legal budget while remaining in range. A path that finishes outside is rejected.

obligations.order135_obligation: Touching bases establish base contact.
obligations.scope: The actual exact circle relation classifies external touching separately from penetration/containment and from a separated endpoint despite near-zero gaps.

obligations.order135_obligation: Overhang-deemed contact requires sufficient move distance to reach hypothetical base contact without the overhang.
obligations.scope: The witnessed contact owner accepts the blocked actual endpoint with four inches and emits the alternative no-overhang contact pose one inch farther. Three inches does not qualify.

obligations.order135_obligation: Overhang-deemed contact requires the closest physically legal endpoint.
obligations.scope: Legal constructed witnesses use the same obstacle and budget. The closest actual endpoint qualifies and the shorter 7.8 endpoint does not.

obligations.order135_obligation: Overhang-deemed contact requires model-part separation of at most one inch.
obligations.scope: Constructed x=8 establishes deemed contact at the certified endpoint. x=6.9 has a gap exceeding one inch and rejects. The negative geometry also fails maximal approach, so the control does not isolate the separation branch independently.

obligations.order135_obligation: Valid overhang-deemed contact expires at the turn's end.
obligations.scope: The owner returns the exact recorded contact before expiry. Synthetic cleanup, next-player and next-round boundary snapshots each remove it from active contact queries.

obligations.order135_obligation: Table quarters are four equal rectangles separated by central lengthwise and widthwise strips one millimetre thick.
obligations.scope: Eight constructed cases cover both center axes, all four signs and gaps bracketing half a millimeter. Cross-quarter pairs cannot produce one qualifying quarter.

obligations.order135_obligation: D6 has six possible faces from one through six.
obligations.scope: Physical dice consumer returns each of the six parametrized native face values. Range-rejection is a separate case.

obligations.order135_obligation: A threshold N+ succeeds for results greater than or equal to N.
obligations.scope: Real fixed-dice battle-shock outcome tests under, exactly at and above the threshold.

obligations.order135_obligation: A stated dice-result range includes both bounds.
obligations.scope: Real Knights table consumer maps the lower and upper result of each listed interval to the same outcome.

obligations.order135_obligation: ND6 sums the specified number of D6 results.
obligations.scope: Dice manager result total equals all requested physical component rolls plus the configured constant.

obligations.order135_obligation: D3 is a physical D6 result halved and rounded upward.
obligations.scope: The result uses every physical D6 face, halves with rounding up and preserves which D6 supplied it.

obligations.order135_obligation: A dice-expression constant is added to the dice sum.
obligations.scope: Dice manager result total equals all requested physical component rolls plus the configured constant.

obligations.order135_obligation: Automatic success skips the dice roll and advances to the next sequence step.
obligations.scope: A real native-body automatic Hit skips its physical roll, advances to Wound and consumes exactly the Wound die.

obligations.order135_obligation: Automatic success does not trigger result-specific or critical-result rules.
obligations.scope: Automatic success has no dice or numeric result and is not critical at the actual native-body Hit owner.

obligations.order135_obligation: A whole-roll reroll rerolls every component of a multi-die sum.
obligations.scope: The whole-roll decision exposes all component IDs and replaces every die of the sum with current physical results.

obligations.order135_obligation: A physical die cannot be rerolled twice.
obligations.scope: Whole-roll and explicitly permitted partial rerolls both reject rerolling the same physical die twice. The invalid request leaves the event log intact.

obligations.order135_obligation: Rerolls precede modifiers.
obligations.scope: The rerolled total reflects replacement dice first, and the modifier is applied to that value once.

obligations.order135_obligation: A rerolled value remains a dice result eligible for result-triggered rules.
obligations.scope: The current total from the replacement components matches the live critical-result predicate independently from its final modified value.

obligations.order135_obligation: Each player rolls one D6 and the highest result wins the roll-off.
obligations.scope: The injected physical D6 pairs on both sides choose the higher result after a tie. Both player winner positions are tested.

obligations.order135_obligation: A tie for highest causes another roll-off.
obligations.scope: A tie in the first D6 pair requires the second roll-off and the final winner is its higher roller.

obligations.order135_obligation: A double requires at least two dice sharing a result.
obligations.scope: Direct configured predicate tests check positive and negative repeat counts for doubles and triples.

obligations.order135_obligation: A triple requires at least three dice sharing a result.
obligations.scope: Direct configured predicate tests check positive and negative repeat counts for doubles and triples.

obligations.order135_obligation: The active player chooses one physical die when multiple dice tie for a referenced highest result.
obligations.scope: The active player receives the tied highest components as distinct physical options and either can be committed.

obligations.order135_obligation: The active player chooses one physical die when multiple dice tie for a referenced lowest result.
obligations.scope: The active player receives the tied lowest components and commits the selected physical die ID.

obligations.order135_obligation: An assigned result activates the same result predicates as that value being rolled.
obligations.scope: An assigned total drives exact and at-least predicates without mutating the original physical D6 result.

obligations.scope: The chosen eligible Character model alone gets WARLORD and the record survives serialization. A nonexistent model index rejects. The live controls reviewed here do not isolate valid-index non-Character and off-faction negatives.

obligations.order135_obligation: Only the selected model receives WARLORD and the roster records its identity.
obligations.scope: Either eligible model can be selected, only that model gets WARLORD, and the validated physical identity survives serialization.

obligations.order135_obligation: If mandatory Warlord units are included, select one eligible mandatory candidate.
obligations.scope: When an eligible mandatory candidate exists, selecting the alternate is rejected and the corresponding mandatory selection is legal.

obligations.order135_obligation: A prohibition on being Warlord overrides a requirement to be Warlord.
obligations.scope: The case with a forbidden mandatory candidate rejects that model while accepting the remaining eligible selection.

obligations.order135_obligation: Every Support unit must attach to a permitted Bodyguard; a Leader may remain unattached.
obligations.scope: An unattached Support and an illegal Bodyguard are rejected while legal Support attachment and a lone Leader muster. The MFM overlay checks which Bodyguard is currently allowed.

obligations.order135_obligation: Enhancements must come from selected detachments and be assigned to distinct eligible units.
obligations.scope: A selected detachment enables its assigned enhancement and rejects an absent grant. Distinct eligible bearer assignments are preserved and same-unit stacking is rejected.

obligations.order135_obligation: Every Enhancement adds its points cost to the assigned unit’s army contribution.
obligations.scope: Each assigned ordinary or Upgrade cost contributes to the army total. Exact-cap vs one-over controls reject the cost excess without changing the request.

obligations.order135_obligation: Ordinary Enhancements require a Character unit and an explicitly selected Character model when the unit has several models.
obligations.scope: Ordinary enhancement rejects a non-Character unit. An invalid physical bearer is rejected and the legal specific Character index is preserved.

obligations.order135_obligation: An Epic Hero model cannot receive an Enhancement.
obligations.scope: Direct selection of the Epic Hero bearer fails specifically. The legal comparison gives the attached unit's Upgrade to its Bodyguard.

obligations.order135_obligation: The army cannot repeat an ordinary Enhancement.
obligations.scope: Valid distinct ordinary assignments contrast with the same ordinary enhancement repeated across the army.

obligations.order135_obligation: Upgrade Enhancements can be assigned to non-Character units.
obligations.scope: An eligible non-Character Bodyguard may actually receive an Upgrade that its ordinary-enhancement control cannot receive.

obligations.order135_obligation: The army may include up to three copies of one Upgrade.
obligations.scope: Up to three copies pass and the fourth produces the Upgrade-specific limit violation.

obligations.order135_obligation: The second and third copies of the same Upgrade do not increase the army Enhancement count.
obligations.scope: Independent size limits count one selected Upgrade ID while retaining two or three physical bearer assignments.

obligations.order135_obligation: Every Upgrade copy still costs its full points value.
obligations.scope: Assigning each copy preserves a separate bearer and the per-copy price crosses the budget only at the expected over-limit totals.

obligations.order135_obligation: Incursion may select one three-DP detachment as its only detachment.
obligations.scope: Three DP is legal for one detachment and illegal across multiple detachments. Ordinary two-DP and invalid individual-cost controls are separate.

obligations.order135_obligation: An attached unit may receive an Upgrade.
obligations.scope: The attached unit's legal Upgrade is recorded once with a specific Bodyguard bearer and retains its identity through JSON.

obligations.order135_obligation: One unit cannot have an Upgrade and another Enhancement simultaneously.
obligations.scope: The assembled attached unit cannot stack a Bodyguard Upgrade and a Leader enhancement. The legal single-assignment control remains intact.

obligations.order135_obligation: Upgrades are a subtype of Enhancement.
obligations.scope: An Upgrade contributes to the shared Enhancement inventory and budget under its subtype rules and preserves all physical assignments.

obligations.order135_obligation: An Epic Hero may attach to a unit carrying an Enhancement without receiving that Enhancement itself.
obligations.scope: An Epic Hero can be in the attached unit with a Bodyguard's Upgrade. Only assigning the enhancement to the Epic model directly is rejected.

obligations.order135_obligation: Independent per-objective definition query plus existing real frozen-control/mission facade consumers; no provider mission-preset certification.
obligations.scope: One native unit controls both overlapping objectives independently. A separate timed boundary control freezes the record across a later conflicting physical evaluation.

obligations.order135_obligation: Same actual model contributes complete OC independently to each result; no global split/deduplication.
obligations.scope: Each of the two independently resolved objectives receives the same exact native model ID and all of its OC, with no global split or deduplication.

obligations.scope: An Action lock remains active across the wrong owner boundary and expires at its own boundary. Frozen control survives a later differing recomputation.
